podcast.body: A quintessential song representing the Quincy Jones' era Michael Jackson stylings, which Bruno Mars explicitly adapted for his summer 2013 electro disco pop R&B track "Treasure." This demonstrates Mars's ability to draw from specific vintage sounds to create new hits. "For his summer 2013 single, Bruno adapted the stylings of Pete Quincy Jones' era Michael Jackson."

podcast.body: Another iconic Michael Jackson hit, "Rock with You" is mentioned as receiving considerably more radio airplay than "You Are Not Alone" as of 2025, serving as an example of his more enduring and popular works. "A fraction of the radio plays now received by other Jackson hits like Billie Jean or Rock with you."
